title: 第861章 甜下第860章 甜中
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
林蔓毫无保留并深情地道：“正因为爱你，所以犯蠢过，怕你嫌弃，怕你在意……
怕世俗的眼光阻挡我们在一起，但现在我不再怕了。”
林蔓眼神直勾勾地看着他，前所未有的坚定。
沈云翔欣慰地笑笑，又宠溺地揉了揉她的发：“这才是我认识的你，真好。”
林蔓感受着他掌心里的温度，心底里充满着力量。
接下来的几天，林蔓一直留在家里面调养。
廖姐得知她没有事，中间来过一次，激动得差点就掉眼泪了。
她甚至想给林蔓跪下，离开之前，一而再地叮嘱说：“我求求你了，你好好保护一下自己，长点心吧，小心一点，不然我这都要给你跪下了。”
林蔓觉得她夸张了，却又觉得有点心酸。
倘若自己真的有事，那么签下的合同公司会赔付不少违约金，就连廖姐也会被牵涉其中。
想到这些，林蔓顿时对她有些心疼，便一而再地保证自己接下来一定会小心谨慎，再不会像现在一样粗心大意了。
这几天沈云翔也一直待在别墅陪着她。
期间他会去书房处理一些问题，无非是关于朱雅雯的下落以及对沈景辞沈望川一事的处理。
万韵诗那天把沈望川的一些资料都拿了过来，基本上是沈望川意图架空沈氏集团的罪证。
他还通过了海外两家公司转移了沈氏集团高达百亿的资产，而海外公司的持股人，更是让他们都意想不到。
对于朱雅雯的搜寻也算是告一段落。
这天洛智博赶紧忙完所有的事情，赶了过来。
万韵诗和柳思哲约好了一起过来，许雾也想见林蔓，所以也自己打车来了。
几人凑巧在门口碰见。
面面相觑后，默契地笑了出声，随后几人一起进入了屋内。

林蔓看到他们过来，开心地小跑着来到他们面前：“哥哥，韵诗姐柳总、许雾，你们来了。”
林蔓这几天胃口不错，吃东西越来越多，长胖了两三斤，但还是瘦。
洛智博满意地看着她的脸色：“嗯，看来这几天休养得还不错，起码脸色有点血色了。”
万韵诗啧啧了两声，将手里提着的燕窝举了举：“这个给你好好补补，再这么瘦下去可就不好看了，干瘪瘪的，老沈他能接受吗？”
柳思哲随即便朝她飞来一个眼刀：“你能不能正经点？人家哥哥还在呢。”
万韵诗一本正经地看向洛智博：“怎么？大家都是成年人，你要介意这个啊？”
洛智博站在万韵诗的旁边，他也很高，整个人的气质憨厚温和。
尤其戴着那副黑框眼镜，藏起了他眼底的情绪。
他急忙转移目光，尴尬地笑了笑：“大家都是朋友，开开玩笑，没什么。”
柳思哲啧了一声。
万韵诗立刻对他斥道：“听到没有？人家哥哥都没意见，你有什么意见？”
柳思哲无奈摇摇头：“行吧，那我不说了。”
许雾开心地上去抱住了林蔓：“蔓蔓，看你现在气色好多了，我就放心了。
奶奶给你炖了黑糯米酒糟，你吃点，说是补气血很猛，不过这算是沿海地区的一些小偏方。”
林蔓听到酒糟两个字，眼前一亮：“我爱吃这个，在哪呢？给我，我现在就吃。”
许雾随即松开怀抱，将手里拎着的袋子举到了面前：“在这，满满两大罐。”
林蔓立刻拿了过来，交给佣人，并让他们给自己热点出来吃。
她立即招呼几人坐下，并对洛智博说：“哥哥，这几天你都没有来，是因为太忙了吗？”
洛智博坐得端端正正，俩手放在腿上，抱歉道：
“这段时间唐氏和望京张家的合作项目开始大力推动新能源领域的发展。”
content_en:
Lin Man said without reservation and affectionately: "Because I love you, I make stupid mistakes, fearing that you will dislike me, fearing that you will care...
I was afraid that the eyes of the world would stop us from being together, but now I am no longer afraid. "
Lin Man looked at him with eyes that were firmer than ever before.
Chen Yunxiang smiled happily, and ruffled her hair lovingly: "This is the you I know, so nice."
Lin Man felt the temperature in his palm, and her heart was filled with strength.
In the next few days, Lin Man stayed at home to recuperate.
When Sister Liao learned that she was fine, she came once and was so excited that she almost shed tears.
She even wanted to kneel down to Lin Man. Before leaving, she warned her again and again: "I beg you, please protect yourself, be more careful, and be careful, otherwise I will kneel down for you right now."
Lin Man thought she was exaggerating, but also felt a little sad.
If something happens to me, the company under the contract will pay a lot of liquidated damages, and even Sister Liao will be involved.
Thinking of this, Lin Man suddenly felt sorry for her, and promised again and again that she would be careful in the future and would never be as careless as now.
Chen Yunxiang has also been staying in the villa to accompany her these days.
During this period, he would go to the study to deal with some issues, which were nothing more than the whereabouts of Zhu Yawen and the handling of Shen Jingci and Shen Wangchuan.
Wan Yunshi brought over some information about Shen Wangchuan that day, which was basically evidence of Shen Wangchuan's intention to seduce the Shen Group.
He also transferred tens of billions of assets of the Shen Group through two overseas companies, and the shareholders of the overseas companies were even more unexpected.
The search for Zhu Yawen has come to an end.
Luo Zhibo quickly finished all his work that day and rushed over.
Wan Yunshi and Liu Sizhe made an appointment to come together. Xu Wu also wanted to see Lin Man, so he took a taxi himself.
Several people happened to meet at the door.
After looking at each other, they laughed in tacit understanding, and then several people entered the house together.
Lin Man saw them coming and trotted up to them happily: "Brother, Sister Yunshi, Mr. Liu, Xu Wu, you are here."
Lin Man had a good appetite these days and ate more and more. She gained two or three pounds, but she was still thin.
Luo Zhibo looked at her face with satisfaction: "Well, it seems that she has been recovering well these days. At least her face is a little brighter."
Wan Yunshi clicked her tongue twice and raised the bird's nest in her hand: "I'll give you a good supplement. It won't look good if you lose weight like this. It's shriveled. Can Old Shen accept it?"
Liu Sizhe then shot a glare at her: "Can you be more serious? My brother is still here."
Wan Yunshi looked at Luo Zhibo seriously: "What? We are all adults, do you mind this?"
Luo Zhibo stood next to Wan Yunshi. He was also very tall and had a simple and gentle temperament.
Especially wearing those black-rimmed glasses, hiding the emotions in his eyes.
He quickly changed his gaze and smiled awkwardly: "We are all friends, we are just joking, it's nothing."
Liu Sizhe clicked his tongue.
Wan Yunshi immediately scolded him: "Did you hear that? My brother doesn't have any objections. What do you have?"
Liu Sizhe shook his head helplessly: "Okay, then I won't say anything."
Xu Wu happily went up and hugged Lin Man: "Manman, I feel relieved to see that you look much better now.
Grandma has stewed black glutinous rice with distiller's grains for you. You eat some of it, saying it is very powerful in replenishing qi and blood, but this is just a small folk remedy from coastal areas. "
When Lin Man heard the word "jiu lees", his eyes lit up: "I love eating this, where is it? Give it to me, I'll eat it now."
Xu Wu immediately let go of his arms and raised the bag in his hand in front of him: "Here, there are two big cans full."
Lin Man immediately took it over, handed it to the servants, and asked them to heat it up for him to eat.
She immediately asked a few people to sit down and asked LuoZhibo said: "Brother, you haven't come these days. Is it because you are too busy?"
Luo Zhibo sat upright, put his hands on his legs, and said apologetically:
"During this period, the cooperation projects between Tang's Group and Wangjing Zhangjia began to vigorously promote the development of the new energy field."
